lines.text: That pizza was totally worth it.

data.define: Used to agree or strongly say something.

example.text: That pizza was totally worth it.

misuse.text: Don't say 'totally' if you partly disagree.

publish.title: What does "totally" mean?
publish.value: Totally = Completely, one hundred percent. Example: "That pizza was totally worth it." (casual English, US).
